items.scope: All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
All products and services developed and/or sold by Panasonic Group companies.
All Airbus products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Airbus that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All current products/software/apps made by Logitech, Ultimate Ears, Jaybird, Streamlabs, Logitech G, Logicool, Blue, and Astro Gaming.
All HiddenLayer systems, services, and products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by HiddenLayer that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Current versions of LINE Messenger Application for iOS, Android, Mac, and Windows, plus LINE Open Source projects hosted on https://github.com/line.
Supermicro branded products, managed system, or software projects.
Products, services, and solutions developed by Canon EMEA, Canon USA Inc., and those from IRIS, NT-ware, Onyx Graphics Inc., and Therefore Corporation, which are not under the Canon Brand.
Everpure (formerly Pure Storage, Inc.) products only.
All Gallagher security products only.
Vulnerabilities in linqi products only.
MongoDB products only, not including end-of-life components or products.
Vulnerabilities in AMI firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by AMI that are not covered by another CNA scope.
Vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Pentraze Cybersecurity that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities identified in Cribl products, and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Cribl that are not in another CNA’s scope.
EA issues only.

Vulnerabilities in the AHA! website and other AHA! controlled assets, as well as vulnerabilities identified in assets owned, operated, or maintained by another organization unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Okta issues only.
Vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bombadil Systems that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Intel branded products and technologies and Intel managed open source projects.
Projects within The Document Foundation only, e.g., LibreOffice, LibreOffice Online; The Document Foundation discourages reporting denial of service bugs as security issues.
StrongDM issues only.
openGauss issues only.
Flock branded hardware and software products only.
Projects listed on its Alibaba GitHub website only.

All Trellix Enterprise (formerly McAfee Enterprise and FireEye) products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Trellix Advanced Research Center (Trellix ACR) that are not in another CNA’s scope.

CVEs requested by code owners using the GitHub Security Advisories feature and vulnerabilities affecting open source projects discovered by security researchers at GitHub or Microsoft not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Ericsson issues only.
Adobe issues only.
Jaspersoft products and services only.
Zoom and Keybase issues only.
Xpdf open source project, including the xpdf viewer and associated command line tools.
All Cato Networks products and vulnerabilities in third-party products affecting Cato products unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Hitachi products excluding Hitachi Energy and Hitachi Vantara products.
All Omnissa products and services, including Workspace ONE and Horizon.
Vulnerabilities in products and services under the Canon brand.
Pegasystems products only.
All Payara Platform product distributions (Payara Server, Micro, Embedded) for both Enterprise (commercial) and Community (OSS) distributions.
All Mattermost issues, and vulnerabilities discovered by Mattermost that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in supported Ivanti products and infrastructure, excluding third-party components, and meeting severity thresholds defined in Ivanti’s Disclosure Policy found here.
Products and projects covered by its bug bounty programs that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities related to products of Mitsubishi Electric Group.
Bizerba products only.
Vulnerabilities in all of Insyde Software’s firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by Insyde Software that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Thinkst Applied Research’s products only.
Third-party products it researches.
PaperCut MF, PaperCut NG, PaperCut Hive, PaperCut Pocket, PaperCut Mobility Print, QRdoc, PaperCut Views, PaperCut Multiverse, https://www.papercut.com, and all other PaperCut products and services.
Vestel-owned brands and products only.
ABB issues only.
Synology issues only.
